title: Apple Music adapter diagnostics and FairPlay flag handling match the legacy path RF-124 restored
acceptance: The playback-failed banner no longer appends a modern-access probe word that describes a path MusicKit does not use.
The unprefixed com.apple.fps probe no longer runs in play() on iOS, or a measured reason to keep it is recorded (coordinate with RF-128).

The stored mk-safari-modern-eme flag is cleared once at MusicKit load instead of at four call sites, and the flag log runs after the key session attaches, with accurate comments (including FAIRPLAY_KEY_SYSTEM).
The desktop test asserts only that the FairPlay key is not removed, not that no removeItem call happens.
Owner hears Start, Next and auto-advance in iPhone Safari Live after the change (provider code, CI cannot prove it).

The #664 review items are handled: on a setQueue timeout the timed-out generation is superseded (claimQueueGeneration), MusicKit's nowPlayingItem is checked before play so a late-settling request cannot play the old song, setQueue uses one try/finally, and a test covers a late settle and the not-destroyed path.
nextAction: Cleanup items 3–9 from the #657 final review, mapped to acceptance: item 3 → banner criterion; item 4 → probe criterion; items 5, 6, 7 and 8 → flag-clear, flag-log and comment criterion; item 9 → desktop test criterion. Files: apps/web/src/lib/musickit.ts, musickit.test.ts, apps/web/src/lib/playback/apple-music-adapter.ts. Owner-gated (playback code). Bundle with RF-121 or RF-128 if either lands first. Also #664 review items 1, 3, 4 and 5 (late-settle overlap, generation not superseded on timeout, missing late-settle test, try/finally simplification), mapped to the last criterion added 2026-10-30.

evidence.summary: Final review of #657: no significant findings; nine non-blocking findings. Item 1 (MusicKit re-writing the flag) is answered by the owner's passing iPhone runs; item 2 (desktop Safari legacy path) is in RF-126.
Final review of #664 (RF-123): no significant findings; logged items 1, 3, 4 and 5 are adapter hardening and cleanup in apple-music-adapter.ts setQueue().
